brief:
Representatives from more than ten nations, including Turkey, left the conference hall as Israeli President Isaac Herzog began his address at the CICA summit in Azerbaijan, Shehab Wire reported. The walkout occurred during the meeting of the Council of Heads of State and Government of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence-Building Measures in Asia.

The boycott reflected ongoing regional tensions linked to Israel's policies and actions in the Middle East.

title: Delegations from 10 countries walk out as Israeli president addresses CICA summit
